coordinate_system: Top-left origin, integer design pixels; bbox right/bottom exclusive. Uniformly scale the whole root, never individually stretch icons.

interaction_contract.other_category_data: Read original project config/icons. No other category data or effects are manufactured in this package.

semantics.unknown: current is null；不可按未解锁处理
semantics.cap: 持有上限；并非解锁门槛
semantics.scope: Virtual-shadow preview only; other archive categories use the project configuration and category contract.

limitations: Preview data does not replace saves or game config.
Only virtual-shadow preview art/data is bundled. Other archive categories reuse the shell and existing project icons.
External game screenshot is preview_only and runtime_use=false.

sidebar_click_region_rule: Non-overlapping intervals divided at adjacent label center midpoints. Selected artwork may visually extend across a click boundary; it must not receive pointer events independently.
